fields.label: User
fields.description: The bidder this profile belongs to - one profile per company/user, feeds the auto-fill in generated bid packs

fields.label: Trading Name
fields.description: Name of bidder as written on the SBD/MBD 1 cover form

fields.label: Registered Name (CIPC)
fields.description: Must match CIPC, CSD and the B-BBEE certificate EXACTLY - one buyer zeroes preference points where records disagree

fields.label: VAT Number
fields.description: Leave empty if not VAT-registered - the pack marks the VAT line for manual completion instead

fields.label: CSD Supplier Number (MAAA)
fields.description: Central Supplier Database registration number. CSD has no supplier API (tender/CSD-API-Findings.md) - keep this current by hand

fields.label: SARS Tax Compliance Status PIN
fields.description: Generate a CURRENT TCS PIN per bid on eFiling - this stored value is the standing PIN, verify freshness before submitting

fields.label: Enterprise Size Class
fields.options:
EME (turnover under R10m - sworn affidavit)
QSE (R10m-R50m - sworn affidavit)
Generic (over R50m - SANAS certificate)
fields.description: Determines whether B-BBEE evidence is a sworn affidavit (EME/QSE) or a SANAS-accredited certificate

fields.label: B-BBEE Level
fields.description: Track the evidence document itself as a Compliance Artifact (B-BBEE Affidavit / B-BBEE Certificate)

fields.label: B-BBEE Evidence Expiry
fields.description: Affidavits are valid 12 months from commissioning. Mirror of the Compliance Artifact valid_until for pack fill

fields.label: CIDB Grading (if any)
fields.description: Exact class and designation, e.g. 6CE, 7GB, 3ME - construction bids only. Must be ACTIVE at close; track the registration as a Compliance Artifact (CIDB Grading)

fields.label: Directors / Members / Trustees
fields.description: List ALL of them - SBD/MBD 4 demands every director with ID and tax numbers; omission invalidates the bid

fields.label: Physical Address
fields.description: Must match CSD/CIPC exactly - locality preference claims verify the address against a municipal account or lease

fields.label: Contact Email
fields.description: Monitored DAILY after submission - clarification/cure windows run from the buyer's email, not from when you read it

fields.label: Authorised Signatory Name
fields.description: The person named in the board/members' resolution - proof of signing authority is fatal-if-missing in every pack

fields.label: Signatory Capacity / Position
fields.description: e.g. Director, Member - stated wherever a form asks the capacity in which you sign

fields.label: Signature Image
fields.description: Sign in dark ink on plain WHITE paper and photograph/scan squarely - the background is stripped automatically (solid colors also handled). Stamped into signature slots ONLY when the user explicitly generates a signed pack

fields.label: Processed Signature (transparent)
fields.description: Background-stripped transparent PNG working copy, regenerated whenever the source image changes - this is what gets stamped

fields.label: Initials Image
fields.description: Initial in dark ink on plain WHITE paper. Stamped into the initial-every-page footer of a signed pack where the form demands per-page initialling

fields.label: Processed Initials (transparent)
fields.description: Background-stripped transparent PNG working copy, regenerated whenever the source image changes

fields.label: Witnesses
fields.description: Several forms (SBD 7, C1.1, NDAs) need witness signatures - a signed pack stamps witness slots from these rows; rows without an image render as marked blanks. Commissioner-of-oaths slots are never stamped: a commissioner must sign in person

fields.label: Bank Details Current on CSD
fields.description: Actual bank details live on the CSD, not here - outdated CSD banking information is a stated cause for disqualification

fields.label: Capability Items
fields.description: Sector evidence the packs keep asking for and the profile could not hold (findings F-07): portfolio/reference sites, hosting infrastructure, data residency, uptime SLAs, security certifications, support tiers - and, sector-extensibly, PSIRA grades, plant/equipment, key personnel. Rows render as a table on capability worksheets (e.g. ICT-CAPABILITY); an empty register renders as a marked profile gap, never silently blank

fields.label: Operating Sectors
fields.description: Comma-separated sectors/keywords the business actually operates in (e.g. ICT, cleaning, security, construction, civil engineering). Matched deterministically against opportunity categories/titles by the suitability scorer (FEEDBACK 1.2) - plain substring matching, no AI.

fields.label: Operating Provinces
fields.description: Comma-separated provinces the business can service (e.g. Limpopo, Gauteng). Leave empty to score geography as undeclared; national/unspecified opportunities match everyone.

fields.label: Briefing Travel Radius
fields.options:
Local (own provinces only)
Neighbouring provinces
National
fields.description: How far the business will travel for a compulsory briefing. Local-only profiles get an extra process-feasibility deduction when a compulsory briefing sits outside the declared operating provinces.

fields.label: COIDA Letter of Good Standing held
fields.description: Compensation Fund letter of good standing, current. Demanded on works / site-based service tenders (GATE-COIDA); feeds the readiness factor's gap list.

fields.label: Municipal Rates Account Current (< 90 days)
fields.description: Municipal rates/services account not older than 90 days (or lease + owner account). Municipal buyers demand it routinely (GATE-RATES); feeds the readiness factor.

fields.label: PSIRA Registered
fields.description: Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority registration - security-sector tenders only; feeds the readiness factor.

fields.label: NHBRC Registered
fields.description: National Home Builders Registration Council registration - home-building tenders only; feeds the readiness factor.

fields.label: Track-Record Evidence Pack Ready
fields.description: Signed reference letters / completion certificates / appointment letters (the 'Trinity of Evidence') collated and current. Feeds the readiness factor where experience evidence is demanded.
